output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large number, the 'totalSupply' += 'mintedAmount' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a negative value, aka 'explode' the totalSupply.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large number, the 'balanceOf[_to] += _value' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'balanceOf[_to]' to a negative value, aka 'explode' the balance.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large number, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'balanceOf[_from]' to a negative value, aka 'explode' the balance.

The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'msg.value' is a large amount, the 'msg.value / buyPrice' or 'amount * sellPrice' operation will cause integer overflow and set a incorrect 'buyPrice' or 'sellPrice', aka 'explode' the 'setPrices' function's integrity.
